result.title: CHEAR: Confusion-Hierarchy Evidence-Aware Reasoning for Cost-Efficient Human Activity Recognition
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a new approach to wearable-sensor-based human activity recognition. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) further introduces similar motion examples and discriminative sensor knowledge, enabling decisions grounded in observations relevant to the current query. More evidence, however, does not necessarily mean better-organized evidence. When online prompts and LLM agents primarily orchestrate inference, decisions about which activities to compare and when to invoke discriminative knowledge remain concentrated at inference time. As the activity vocabulary grows, the model must repeatedly process more candidates and associated knowledge, whereas pruning candidates too early risks excluding the true activity. We propose confusion-hierarchy evidence-aware reasoning (CHEAR), which moves part of this knowledge organization offline. CHEAR constructs and validates an activity hierarchy from recurrent cross-subject retrieval errors and builds corresponding activity-pair knowledge. At inference time, the hierarchy orders candidate comparisons; the LLM retains candidates progressively, and local discriminative knowledge is accessed only for the remaining activities. Across eight datasets, CHEAR achieves 86.79\% mean cross-subject accuracy, a 75.91\% candidate reduction rate, and 96.44\% true-activity retention. Per-sample token use is 85.15\% lower on average than in a variant without the hierarchical structure. Mean accuracy across eight cross-dataset transfer directions is 88.81\%. These results show that organizing candidates and discriminative knowledge around observed activity confusions reduces online LLM input while maintaining recognition performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CHEAR：用跨被试检索错误构建并验证活动混淆层级与活动对判别知识，把候选比较顺序和知识的组织部分移到离线；推理时 LLM 按层级逐步保留候选，仅对剩余活动访问局部判别知识。在八个穿戴传感器数据集上报告了跨被试/跨数据集识别精度、候选缩减率与 token 消耗的下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属传感活动识别而非视觉推理，但「混淆层级驱动的候选渐进剪枝 + 按需调用判别证据」与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算及何时获取证据的决策可能相通，可供核查其离线组织与在线保留策略能否迁移。
